---
name: 'Feature request'
about: 'Suggest an idea for Freetz-EVO'
title: 'feature: <short description>'
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

## Summary

Briefly describe the feature you would like to see in Freetz-EVO.

## Use case

What problem does it solve, and for whom? (e.g. "I want to run X on my 7590 AX
so that I can ...")

## Proposed solution

Describe how the feature could work, including any relevant packages,
libraries, or configuration options.

## Alternatives

Any alternative approaches you considered.

## References

- Link to the upstream project / package (if any)
- Link to related discussions
- Relevant documentation pages

---

**Note:** Freetz-EVO also welcomes feature requests as pull requests — look at
the [package development guide](https://ircama.github.io/freetz-evo/) and the
[discussions](https://github.com/Ircama/freetz-evo/discussions) for guidance.
